truth_source: Author-coded 4-item quiz is not document recommendation truth. Document qrels are absent from the archived study package, but the external original Cranfield archive was directly recovered (SW-S34). The task prompt matches source query .I002 after case/whitespace normalization and ignoring terminal question-mark/period; cranqrel lines30–54 contain25 graded judgments (1:2, 2:5, 3:13, 4:4, -1:1). README defines1 as highest relevance and4 as minimal interest, but does not define-1; grade5 no-interest entries are stated omitted. The human study binary relevance threshold, deployed corpus/version, actual candidate exposure and condition mapping remain unverified. Unlisted items and-1 are not classified as objectively wrong.
